title: The first jazz band she heard: Mack's band from New Orleans
summary: Ida says the first jazz band she heard was a New Orleans band led by Thomas Mack, and that she later worked with him.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was the very first jazz band you ever heard?
Mack and his Mirror Middle came here from New Orleans.
Thomas Mack? Thomas Mack. You know Mack?
Oh, no, you know Mack, Tom?
I don't know Mack, but I heard plenty about it. Yeah.

And then I worked with him, too. Edmund Hall? No, Thomas Mack. I worked with him a while. I do, too. He's working at the West New York office now. I telegraphed all these words, Porta de la. Oh, yeah. It's funny, I never met him. I worked with Mack and Thomas. Know who he looked like, Dick? Him and Thomas compared to brothers. Him and Kid Thomas? No, yeah, Kid Thomas compared to brothers. Mack and Thomas. Same height and everything, color and everything. Compared to brothers.
